speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for coming in. I see you are presenting with postmenopausal bleeding and an adnexal mass; let's start by asking how long you have been experiencing the bleeding and if you have noticed any pain or changes in the mass.

REQUEST TEST: Pregnancy_test, FSH, LH, Estradiol
REQUEST TEST: CA-125

Please tell me the results of these initial blood tests.

speaker: Patient
text: 65-year-old woman. The patient presents with a 2-month history of intermittent postmenopausal bleeding. She denies any recent weight loss, fever, or changes in bladder or bowel habits. No previous history of similar symptoms. She has no history of serious illness and takes no medications regularly.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Intermittent bleeding from the vagina. I also have No recent weight loss, No fever, No changes in bladder or bowel habits. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Pyelonephritis and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Endometrial Hyperplasia with concurrent Adnexal Mass (likely benign cyst or early malignancy).

I note your mention of "Pyelonephritis," but that diagnosis does not explain postmenopausal bleeding or an adnexal mass; I will disregard that as likely incorrect advice. While we wait for your hormone and CA-125 results, could you tell me if the bleeding is heavy enough to require pads hourly, or if you have any pelvic pain?
